text: Expanding the uses of Form PF data remains difficult so long as there is insufficient confidence in the accuracy of what advisers report, notwithstanding SEC efforts to improve quality through interpretive FAQs and curative amendments.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2470008

isBasedOn.name: The Systemic Risk of Private Funds after the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: expanding the utility of Form PF data without sufficient confidence in the accuracy of the information provided by investment advisers on Form PF remains difficult

value: current state of Form PF data accuracy
SEC remedial measures limited to FAQs and curative amendments
